card.name: Social media and web posting text
card.fires_on: Scattered positions inside web text about social media, comment threads and online posting, such as the space before a user count, "Posted" in a comment footer, or "://" in a link. It is strongest where the next word would be a social-media or blog term.

modes.label: Social media statistics
modes.description: Spaces or numbers in sentences about Facebook user counts.
modes.example: Currently, Facebook has over 500 million active users with<< >>250 million users accessing their accounts

modes.label: Comment footers
modes.description: Words and digits in "Report abuse Posted by" comment lines with dates.

modes.label: Links and online actions
modes.description: The "://" in social media or news links, or verbs about doing things online.
modes.example: Follow Sam Hananel on Twitter: http<<://>>twitter.com/SamHananelAP

card.writes: It lowers the odds of social media and blog names such as Twitter, Reddit, Instagram and blog.
card.plain: It fires in web text about social media and online posting, and it holds back the names of those sites as the next word.
